task:
The system of <ToStar> (planet <ToPlanet>) is going to host the annual music festival, which has been long considered the most prestigious festival in the entire Galaxy. This year they are celebrating their 300 anniversary, so it is very important for us that we win. This year's winner will be remembered forever in history! 

Unfortunately the band that we planned to put on the bill this year, got into jail because of a stupid drug-incident. We need to find a replacement and soon. We heard that you were a good singer, and back in your younger years were even playing some hyper-rock band. This is why we have chosen you, ranger <Ranger>. According to our estimates you have a couple of days left to complete the line-up for the band. Of course this is not enough time, but there will be a whole lot of musicians at the festival, and we expect that you will be able to sign them in. We will mail you some other details later. 

The mission budget is <clr>1200<clrEnd> rockarollars - that's the local currency - which you will receive in the hotel. We are also paying all of your accommodation expenses. Oh yes, and before I forgot, you must be on the planet of <ToPlanet> not later than <Date>. Good luck!
success: Hoorah, we are the winners! Ranger <Ranger>, do you even understand that you've just become the most successful musician in this whole Galaxy! This was the best show I've ever seen. The entire planet here was watching the show on the stereovision, cheering for you, you even have a fan club now! From this moment on you will always be a welcome guest on our planet, we will even erect a monument to you, if we have enough hologram. Here's you promised fee of <Money> cr, and stay tuned, <Ranger> the Great. Rock on!!!
loc.1.0:
When you landed on the planet of <ToPlanet> it was late in the evening already. The security check did not take long, they asked you about the purpose of your visit and took away your weapons for the time of your stay here. You left the spaceport and noticed it was rather warm here despite the northern winds. A couple of minutes in hover-taxi and you are already in a beautiful hall of an expensive hotel. The clerk at the desk gave you the promised <clr>1200<clrEnd> rockarollars and the smart-key from your room, paid by the <FromPlanet> government.

As soon as you entered the room, you crashed on the cushy bed and fell fast asleep, missing the supper, which was not in your habit. You were in for a hard long day...

Morning crept in and the bright rays of the local sun lit the room.
loc.62.0: You are in your room, furnished in the traditional Human <clr>"quick-and-dirty"<clrEnd> manner, very fashionable these days. The huge window overlooks the main square. There is an outdated hotel <clr>laptop<clrEnd> on the bedside table. The bed is to the right, with a stereovision hovering above it showing a hatch-ball match, music videos and a commercial, advertising some new cool gun that can penetrate any armour and costs only <clr>4999.99<clrEnd> cr (and if you call straight away you will also get a free bottle of special varnish, which would make the gun shine like a copper basin).
loc.62.1: Lazily you got out of bed, went to the shower, after which you had a stuffy breakfast sitting on the sofa and watching the stereovision.
loc.62.2:
You were so tired that you fell asleep right where you were standing. Most naturally this did not improve your mood much, but it least it was in a hotel, not outside! 

In the morning you woke up, washed your face and tried to pull yourself more or less together.
loc.62.3: You went back to the hotel. Passing through a long corridor, you found yourself in a small but rather cosy room.
loc.62.4: Boy is it nice to have some rest when you know all business has been taken care of! So you spent the rest of the day and night lying in your room, watching the stereovision and doing nothing. Such a pastime could not but boost your morning spirits!
loc.62.5: You lied in your room till it was dark. After all big city nights offer a completely different life!
loc.64.0:
You are standing in the main square of planet <ToPlanet>. As usual it is rather crowded in the square, with the absolute majority of folks being Humans. 

Behind you is the <clr>hotel<clrEnd>, and in front of you is the <clr>studio<clrEnd>, that offers all sorts of opportunities for the musicians. To your left is a regular <clr>pub<clrEnd>, not any different from any other pub on any other Human planet. Next to it there is a <clr>tattoo-parlour<clrEnd>. In the distance there is a small <clr>rock-club<clrEnd>. Across the street runs a long <clr>street<clrEnd>. The last thing that caught your attention was a huge hatch-ball <clr>stadium<clrEnd> where the concert will be held. 

<clr>At night<clrEnd> only the <clr>pool-room<clrEnd> and the <clr>pub<clrEnd>, are open since they work 24x7.

jump.312.desc: You decided to follow the example of the dude from this popular band called "Rock Hard Chilly Peppers", who would undress completely at each gig. jump.314.desc: You started running about the stage like crazy screaming your head off. At first the audience looked indifferent, but when somebody threw a rotten tomato at you, and caught you right on the head, everybody split their sides with laughter. Angered, you took what was left of the projectile and launched it back into the audience, but did not quite calculate the trajectory and hit one of the promoters. He grimly showed you a fist, and the audience started laughing even more!
jump.315.desc: You started running about the stage like crazy screaming your head off. On the downside, after this incident the instruments went a little out of tune, so the band would now sound a bit worse.
jump.316.desc: You started coming up with new lyrics, and did a good job at that remembering some cool lines from a <clr>book<clrEnd>, that you read online the other day. The audience thought that was pretty smart and started applauding!

jump.318.desc: You directed the maxiphone into the audience but they did not want to sing along. As a result there was a dropout in the sound, and you even heard somebody crack a joke. The joke was very funny, and everybody started laughing!
jump.319.desc: You directed the maxiphone into the audience, and they started shouting something, it was cool. Only that when the turn reached the Pelengs, they started screaming all kinds of obscenities, and it downed your rating a little bit.
jump.320.desc: You grabbed a bottle of beer and were about to throw it to the audience, but suddenly you felt a strike of greediness. You corked open the bottle and killed it in one swing. The crowd was outraged by this act of mockery. Trying to save the day, you took another bottle, but greet got the better of you again. You gave up the idea and threw the remaining bottles backstage.
jump.321.desc: You snatched a couple of beer bottles and hurled them into the crowd, initiating a fight - free beers are a rarity in these parts. As a result the tow persons to get the beer were a strong Maloq and a quick Peleng, the rest of the audience gave you an evil look. You took the remaining bottles and threw them to other members of the audience. Now the evil looks were directed at you from the stage where your band-members stood - apparently it was their beer. The mood of the band went down, but the audience was cheering.
jump.322.desc: You dived off the stage and into the crowd, and they started carrying you across the stadium, but when the turn reached the Faeyans, they failed it and dropped you. jump.323.desc: You dived off the stage and into the crowd, but either they weren't expecting it or they simply decided to fool you, instead of catching you the audience parted. But the audience was still laughing at you and your mood was slightly spoiled.

jump.703.desc:
You met the bar-owner and asked him if your band could play that night. At first he would not agree, and only after said you were going to play for free, did he condescend. He did not have to share and still could seriously increase the reputation of his bar. 

You climbed on stage hearing the crowd boo. They definitely did not like you. Nonetheless you started playing, but you cranked up the volume so much, that half of the hall left immediately. However the half that stayed soon started getting into it and cheered. By the end of the song, everybody was giving you a thumbs up, and after the song was over, the barroom continued singing the chorus for another good five minutes. When you were leaving the stage, you swore to come back and used the opportunity to urge them to support you tomorrow. <clr>The band's overall skill has also improved after that short gig.<clrEnd>

But, as luck would have it, the bar owner was not pleased, to say the least - in fact he was in proper fury. The crowd in the barroom broke all the table, chairs and all the other furniture. When you asked him if you could play again, he answered something negative in an ancient Human language that now had been completely forgotten.

Half a minute later both bottles were empty already and you threw them right into the hall. The crowd was amazed by your coolness and gave you a long applause. But, the beer turned out to be extra-strong and cold, which couldn't but affect your vocal cords.
jump.750.desc: You decided to follow the example of the dude from this popular band called "Rock Hard Chilly Peppers", who would undress completely at each gig. However, apparently, the gig security did not like this dude and did not approve of such tricks. The menacing Maloqs quickly ran up to you, kicked you a couple of times and forced you to dress. The audience was not very pleased with this and shouted obscenities at you.
jump.752.desc: Calmly the Gaalian told you that you were mistaken, just like everyone else had been. Then he sank back into thought.
jump.756.desc: Congratulations, you returned your stake and won {50} rockarollars!!! Looks like it's true what they say about <clr>drunks<clrEnd> being lucky!
jump.757.desc: Congratulations, you returned your stake and won {50} rockarollars!!! That's what reading a <clr>book about pool<clrEnd> can do.
jump.759.desc: Today you were in <clr>excellent mood<clrEnd> and you hand was steady. After a long struggle you won against your opponent. Now you had a <clr>keyboardist<clrEnd>!
jump.761.desc: You went down to the crowd to talk to your fans and give them a couple of autographs. However your  <clr>mood<clrEnd> was so bad, that the audience felt it. Your rude answers to their questions cost you several rating points.
jump.762.desc: You went down to the crowd to talk to your fans and give them a couple of autographs. However you were so <clr>drunk<clrEnd>, that you couldn't even put a proper signature on the T-shirts of your female fans. The audience did not quite like it.
jump.763.text: Send it all to hell and leave
jump.766.desc: - Too bad, - said the bass-player. - But if you reconsider, come back.
jump.767.desc: Looks like your rehearsals did you a world of good, your poetic skills got through to the audience, half of the crowd started crying and went sad...
jump.768.desc: You started singing something poetic into the maxiphone but you would constantly fall into obscenities. Nothing poetic at all. Maybe you should not have gotten so <clr>drunk<clrEnd>. The audience was very displeased.
jump.795.desc: You ordered <clr>fireworks<clrEnd> around the scene. It looked as if the band was playing in a ring of fire. The effect looked real cool and the crowd stood in amazement! Bright sparks were streaming all over the scene, boosting you rating up.
jump.796.desc: You ordered an <clr> alternating background<clrEnd>, in order to brighten things up on stage a little. All kinds of cool picture started appearing on the backdrop: different musical instruments, fancy hover mobiles and Dominators. Your rating increased a little!
jump.797.desc: You ordered <clr>artificial rain<clrEnd>, one of the most complex and expensive effects. Maybe this was the reason why it failed. A multitude of charges rocketed into the sky, and exploded to the sound of your music! However instead of the supposed rain, the audience was blinded by a dozen of bright flashes. Most naturally the sensation was not that pleasing to the crowd. Too bad you cannot explain it to them, that the only person to blame for this was the stupid pyro-technician who took the wrong charges...
jump.798.desc: You thought that it was about time to start the <clr>laser show<clrEnd> to cheer up the audience! But alas, it almost had no effect on the audience. Looks like this old effect was already all out of fashion...
jump.799.desc: The <clr>Sky Fireworks<clrEnd> took years to prepare and was over all too soon. The rave of colours that turned the sky into an amazing play of lights lasted only for some 20 seconds, but even that was enough to seriously increase your rating!
jump.800.desc: Alright, time for some <clr> holographic effects<clrEnd>! You ordered a huge monster that appeared over the stadium is several seconds! Unfortunately the dumb Maloq security guards did not figure this one out and started shooting at the hologram. It took about 30 seconds for the chief of security to calm them down. However the audience was still pleased.
jump.801.desc: The moment you ordered the <clr>light effects<clrEnd>, the light went out. The audience booed, but in mere second the stadium lit up with hyper-searchlights! The beautiful colourful lights entranced the audience, yourself, and even those who were not present at the gig, and watched the show through the window or from their balconies. The whole city lit with colours! You rating skyrocketed!
jump.805.desc: Your mood was bad, so the interview turned out to be a bit on the rude side, and you did not even thank the audience for their support. However, much thanks to the beers you had drunk, you cracked up a couple of dubious jokes which pleased a certain part of the audience, so your rating did not drop as much as it could have. The reporter did not want to spend too much time with you and took off as soon as there was a pause in your conversation.
jump.806.desc: Your spirits were high, and besides you already were a little tipsy. These two factors combined ensured that your interview - that was aired live on stereovision - went easy and was nice and funny. You finished off by saying hello to all the rangers you knew, and promising to break their necks, if they would again steal Dominator remains from under your nose. You also thanked the audience for the support and promised to rid the Galaxy of Dominator presence by the time of the next concert. The audience laughed at your jokes which could not but improve your rating.
jump.807.desc: You went over to the reporter and said: "Alright, creep, I want an interview!" Not expecting this, he got scared, dropped the mike and ran off. You picked up the microphone and started cursing at everyone in a drunken voice. You rating dropped considerably! You shouldn't have gotten that <clr>drunk<clrEnd>...
jump.808.desc: You made a good interview, sent your regards to all the rangers you knew and Ma, thanked the audience and sang a verse from your song as a token of gratitude. And since you were one heck of a singer, your rating certainly improved much!
jump.809.desc: Unfortunately your forecast about this player was wrong and he lost the game, and so did you. Had you been <clr>reading<clrEnd> a bit more, maybe you would have made a better choice, about who you stake on.
jump.816.desc: Alright, time for some <clr> holographic effects<clrEnd>! You ordered a huge monster that appeared over the stadium is several seconds! The monster flew all over the place, spat fire, and did all kinds of weird thing! The crowd roared in amazement and your rating skyrocketed!
jump.817.desc: Alright, time for some <clr> holographic effects<clrEnd>! You ordered a huge monster that was to appear over the stadium. But unfortunately you were too <clr>drunk<clrEnd> to operate the equipment and the monster was way too high in the sky. Very few people managed to see it and it almost had no effect on the audience.
jump.818.desc: The <clr>Sky Fireworks<clrEnd> were supposed to become the climax of your performance! However the promoters decided to save up on this effect, and instead of buying the expensive Gaalian fireworks, bought the defected Peleng ones. Many of the rockets simply did not work. As a result the fireworks were not that impressive, and you rating did not grow as much as you'd expected.
jump.819.desc: The moment you ordered the <clr>light effects<clrEnd>, the light went out. The audience grasped for air, but... Nothing happened! The hyper-searchlights that were supposed to turn on and colour the stadium in beautiful lights, for some reason would not work. The audience started booing...
jump.820.desc: The moment you ordered the <clr>light effects<clrEnd>, the whole stadium lit up with hyper-searchlights! Colourful and beautiful they would have left the audience and you gaping in awe... Had this idiot of a light technician not forgotten to put the lights out!!! This way the entire effect was blurred although the audience did like it after all.
jump.821.desc: You thought that it was about time to start the <clr>laser show<clrEnd> to cheer up the audience! The old time-tested effect has totally lived up to your expectations. Red laser beams started running across the stadiums as if there was a million marksmen with IR-sights on the roof! Everyone was overjoyed, you inclusive!
jump.822.desc: You ordered <clr>fireworks<clrEnd> around the scene. It looked as if the band was playing in a ring of fire. The effect looked real cool and the crowd was entranced! Bright sparks were streaming all over the scene, boosting you rating up. Too bad though, the spark of from the bad Maloq firework caught your <clr>bass-player<clrEnd> on the arm and burnt him badly. He will not be able to demonstrate good musicianship tonight.
jump.823.desc: You ordered <clr>fireworks<clrEnd> around the scene. It looked as if the band was playing in a ring of fire. The effect looked real cool and the crowd was shocked! But, drunk as you were, you had your calcs wrong, and one of the PA speakers caught fire! Of course they put the fire out immediately, but the sound of the band would be much worse than in the beginning.
jump.824.desc: You ordered <clr>fireworks<clrEnd> around the scene. It looked as if the band was playing in a ring of fire. The effect looked real cool and the crowd was impressed! Unfortunately the drummer was sitting too close to the line of fire and suddenly his drum-kit caught fire! You had to quickly drop the burning drum off the stage. The audience roared thinking this was part of the show. However the <clr>drummer<clrEnd> himself was not that happy about the incident, with one drum missing he wouldn't be able play that well tonight.
jump.825.desc: You ordered an <clr> alternating background<clrEnd>, in order to brighten things up on stage a little. All kinds of cool picture started appearing on the backdrop: different musical instruments, fancy hover mobiles and Dominators. However the audience did not appreciate this effect.
jump.826.desc: You ordered <clr>artificial rain<clrEnd>, one of the most complex and expensive effects. A multitude of charges shot into the air and blasted accompanied by your music! And then the whole stadium was covered by rain - exactly like a real one! But that wan was gleaming in different colours and shined in the night sky! The audience liked it, it was not something you saw everyday!
jump.827.desc: You sneaked on stage behind the curtains with plans to cut a whole in one of the tweeters, so that it would rattle during the performance of remaining acts, which would certainly take about 10 rating points from them. However as soon as you took your knife out, you heard somebody's steps. You hardly had the time to leap behind the curtain, when the Alumminica singer went right to the speaker you were fumbling with to have a smoke. Damn you nearly got busted! You decided not to risk like that again.
jump.828.desc: You were not in your best <clr>mood<clrEnd>, and not <clr>drunk<clrEnd> enough either. Which is why the interview was rather boring and the audience did not like it.
jump.829.desc: You did a good interview, said hello to everyone you were supposed to, thanked the audience and promised to come back again next year with a new album. The usual thing, you know. Your rating has somewhat increased.
jump.830.desc: No theoretic knowledge would ever help you win a pool game if you are <clr>drunk<clrEnd>! You did not manage to win that game. The happy keyboardist went home. He will not be back here again today.
param.0.crit: You were so tired, that you fell asleep right where you were standing. The guards thought you were a tramp and delivered you to the police station, where the local hoodlums in you cell cut your throat...
param.1.crit: Не знаю, где вы шлялись, но концерт уже прошел. Вы не оправдали возложенных на вас надежд и теперь с позором улетите отсюда.
param.3.crit: У вас совершенно не было настроения, для каких-либо действий. Оставшиеся дни вы просто провалялись в гостинице смотря стереовизор.
param.3.show.2: You are not in your best mood
param.3.show.3: You are in a good mood
param.4.crit: You got drunk and went for a walk about the city. Maybe, if you had not been screaming something like: "Your problem is you!" and "I wanna be an Anarchist!", you would have stayed alive, and the local rabbles wouldn't have slit your throat.
param.5.crit: Вы так устали, что уснули прямо здесь. Наутро вас подобрала полиция и привела вас в участок, с просьбой покинуть планету <ToPlanet> всвязи с отклоненным от нормы поведением. Миссия была провалена.
param.5.show.3: You have dragon and guitar tats
param.20.show.1: You know the rules of etiquette
param.21.show.1: The keyboardist frequents the pool room
param.24.show.1: You know how to play pool
param.27.show.1: Вы знаете как выиграть в бильярд
